requirement: The system shall refuse to debit an account when the requested amount exceeds the account's available balance.
The system shall move funds between two accounts atomically so that either both the debit and the credit are recorded or neither is.
The customer enters a payee account number and an amount; the system validates the account number, checks the available balance and submits the payment for processing.
The user chooses two of their own accounts; the system shows the available balance on both and moves the chosen amount between them instantly.
As a customer, I want to view the running balance and a paginated list of transactions for one of my accounts so that I can reconcile spending.
As a bank operations officer, I want to place a hold on an account so that no outgoing payments are permitted while an investigation is open.
A customer may only send an external payment of more than the configured large-amount threshold after completing a second authentication factor.
Every monetary movement affecting an account must be recorded in an immutable ledger entry with the amount, direction and resulting balance.
The ledger table shall ensure every entry carries a non-zero amount and that a closed account cannot receive new ledger entries.
hard_negatives:
-- scheduled transfer instruction table
CREATE TABLE scheduled_transfer (
    instruction_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    from_account     VARCHAR(34)   NOT NULL,
    to_account       VARCHAR(34)   NOT NULL,
    amount           NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL,
    execute_on       DATE          NOT NULL,
    status           VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT sched_amount_positive CHECK (amount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT sched_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('BOOKED','EXECUTED','CANCELLED'))
);
-- account master table
CREATE TABLE account (
    account_number   VARCHAR(34) PRIMARY KEY,
    owner_id         VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    currency         CHAR(3)     NOT NULL,
    balance          NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    overdraft_limit  NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status           VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    opened_at        TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT account_balance_not_null CHECK (balance IS NOT NULL)
);

requirement: A customer must be able to see only their own accounts and transactions through the online banking interface, never another customer's.
The overnight batch shall charge the agreed monthly account fee to every current account that is open, in credit, and not already charged for the current fee period.
